variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, wants her amulet back from the Urchins of the old barrow.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Greetings, brave Wanderer! Please, help me, a dreadful thing has happened at my mill!

Not long ago, a band of Urchins crept in through the yard. They stole my amulet and ran off to their barrow! I could ward them off if I only had it, but they took it east of the ford. I'm afraid they'll be back to wreck the mill if I go out after it!

Will you fetch it back for me? I will give a good reward for its quick return.

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Fine then, leave my amulet with the Urchins!

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: Why are you standing there? I need my amulet back!

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: Oh, thank you kindly, Wanderer! I could never pay you in full for this... But please, take this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Retrieve Wenna's amulet from the Urchins' barrow.

journal_done.text: Return the amulet to Wenna at the mill.

variants.specifics: Skarn Delve: Pellwick the assayer has had the Rod of Seeking stolen by a Troll and sends the player on to Dorvak with it

offer.speaker: Pellwick
offer.text: Ooooh, how can this be? That filthy Troll beat both of my helpers. Will you go after him? Quickly, you must stop him before the Rod of Seeking is lost.

refusal.speaker: Pellwick
refusal.text: Oh dear. Then come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Pellwick
reminder.text: Please, I implore you. Catch that cowardly Troll and bring back the Rod of Seeking.

completion.speaker: Pellwick
completion.text: The Rod of Seeking is saved! Dorvak will need my Sounding Bell to read the new seams. Here, carry them both down to him.

after.speaker: Pellwick
after.text: You may have saved the whole Delve with this. Well done, lad! Now, hurry down to Dorvak.

journal.text: Recover the Rod of Seeking stolen by the Troll.

journal_done.text: Take the Rod of Seeking and the Sounding Bell to Dorvak.

variants.specifics: Gorrow: Mayor Pellan's amulet, stolen by the Mud Imps, who took it into the sinkhole south of Gorrow

offer.speaker: Pellan
offer.text:
Welcome to Gorrow, noble Adventurer! We've been expecting you!

The Mud Imps who live below the walks have gone wild! They crept up the posts and stole my Amulet! A Hunter chased the little brutes into the sinkhole, but hasn't come back.

Will you go into the sinkhole to the South and recover my Amulet from the Imps? Come see me once you are back. I'll be home on the big platform.

refusal.speaker: Pellan
refusal.text: Oh, bah! Then the Imps can keep it!

reminder.speaker: Pellan
reminder.text: Those pesky Imps are up to no good again these days.

completion.speaker: Pellan
completion.text:
My Amulet! Thank you, kind sir! All Gorrow is truly thankful for your fine work.

Here, take this as a small gift from the hamlet. The Captain is waiting at the landing. You should visit the shops first, then go and talk to him at once.

after.speaker: Pellan
after.text: There is nothing more I can give you but my gratitude. You ought to find the Captain. He is waiting down at the landing.

journal.text: Recover Mayor Pellan's amulet from the Mud Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Mayor Pellan's amulet from the Mud Imps.

variants.specifics: Karth Vael: Odlin lost his fur cloak to an imp in the loft above the kennels, and the hounds now bite anyone who enters the yard.

offer.speaker: Odlin
offer.text:
Good! My family keeps the finest hounds in Karth Vael. Unfortunately, a nasty little imp has moved into the loft above our kennel and run off with my fur cloak. He has stirred up the hounds and now they snap at anyone who enters the yard.

Go get the cloak back from the imp, and I'll make it worth your while. Will you go?

Here, take this whistle, it will calm the hounds.

refusal.speaker: Odlin
refusal.text:
Too bad, nobody else will go near that yard.

Come and find me if you think better of it, I'm at the kennels by the stables.

reminder.speaker: Odlin
reminder.text: Don't fret, one little imp is no match for you. Come back with my cloak.

completion.speaker: Odlin
completion.text:
Excellent! You've got my cloak back.

Here is your reward. The red potion will put you back on your feet. Good luck!

after.speaker: Odlin
after.text: Thanks again for getting my cloak back.

journal.text: Retrieve Odlin's fur cloak from the Imp in the kennel loft.

journal_done.text: NOTE: Odlin has his cloak back and the hounds are quiet.

variants.specifics: Orlmere: Dorrel is waiting on a Cloak of Tides that the maker Skerrik has not delivered from his hut on Eel Island.

offer.speaker: Dorrel
offer.text:
Skerrik has been working on a Cloak of Tides for me for some time. He should have been done with it and had it brought to me by now.

Take the old pier out to Skerrik's hut on Eel Island and find the Cloak. Will you go?

refusal.speaker: Dorrel
refusal.text: Oh, I see. Well, the offer stands if you come back.

reminder.speaker: Dorrel
reminder.text: Find Skerrik and bring the Cloak to me -- at whatever the cost! Beware of the reed channels. Nasty things lurk under the pier!

completion.speaker: Dorrel
completion.text:
You found the Cloak of Tides! Wonderful!

My worst fears for Skerrik, however, have come true. I'll miss him, but there is no time for grief. Orlmere needs me and Rudge wants a word with you. Take this Blue Potion for your trouble.

Good luck, brave Adventurer!

after.speaker: Dorrel
after.text: Thanks again for all your trouble.

journal.text: Retrieve the Cloak of Tides which Skerrik has made.

journal_done.text: Return the Cloak of Tides to Dorrel.

variants.specifics: Zorreth: Dorrick's Cloak of Warding, woven by his colleague Yarnak, was carried off by the Gargoyles to the ruined bell tower.

offer.speaker: Dorrick
offer.text:
While I look into what is troubling our college, there's another job that needs doing.

Yarnak, a colleague of mine, finished the Cloak of Warding I asked for, but the Gargoyles carried it off from his cottage.

Beyond the college wall there is a ruined bell tower where the Gargoyles roost. They carry everything they steal up there. You may leave by the garden door at the back of this hall.

Please fetch my cloak back and let Yarnak know it is safe.

Will you help me, Apprentice?

refusal.speaker: Dorrick
refusal.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Think it over and come back.

reminder.speaker: Dorrick
reminder.text: Go to the bell tower and find my cloak! Now!

completion.speaker: Dorrick
completion.text:
You found the Cloak of Warding! Excellent!

Sadly, my worst fears for Yarnak's cottage have come true. I shall miss his fine work, but we have no time for sorrow, I'm afraid. The Gate Wardens need my help and Rector Ulbrin asks for your assistance.

Please take this potion. Good luck!

after.speaker: Dorrick
after.text: Thanks again for finding my cloak!

journal.text: Retrieve the Cloak of Warding which the Gargoyles stole from Yarnak.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve the Cloak of Warding which the Gargoyles stole from Yarnak.

variants.specifics: Kell Varn: Mylka, who keeps the magic shop, lost her Amulet of Warmth to the Imps

offer.speaker: Mylka
offer.text:
Wretched little fiends! The Imps have crept into my cellar and made a mess of everything already!

I am Mylka. I am looking for my Amulet of Warmth. I fear it has been carried off to a nearby Imp Nest.

If you could get it back from them, I would be willing to teach you a spell or two. Will you search the wretched Imp Nest for it?

refusal.speaker: Mylka
refusal.text: Oh. Well, come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Mylka
reminder.text: Have you got my amulet back yet? Oh my, I feel so cold.

completion.speaker: Mylka
completion.text:
My Amulet of Warmth! I feared it was lost for good.

You are braver than you look. Perhaps you might make a fine student.

Follow me to the counter. Please take this Blue Potion with my thanks. We have much to discuss when you return from your quest.

after.speaker: Mylka
after.text: Whenever you are free, step up to my counter and we will begin.

journal.text: Recover Mylka's Amulet of Warmth from the Imp Nest.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Mylka's Amulet of Warmth from the Imp Nest.

variants.specifics: Ashkar: Tilda's enchanted hammer Gertie was carried off by Imps to their den.

offer.speaker: Tilda
offer.text:
Please, help me, kind stranger! The Imps have raided my forge and carried off my poor enchanted hammer, Gertie, to their den!

Will you bring her back? I'll be in your debt forever!

refusal.speaker: Tilda
refusal.text: No? Oh.... Well, come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Tilda
reminder.text: Take whatever you find in the den! Just hurry and fetch Gertie!

completion.speaker: Tilda
completion.text:
Thank goodness, you got her back! How can I ever thank you for your courage?!

What's that you say? A pile of gold? Well, if gold is what you want, please take this as a sign of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Tilda
after.text: Thanks again for fetching her, kind stranger!

journal.text: Get Gertie the Magic Hammer back from the Imps near Ashkar.

journal_done.text: NOTE: Gertie the Magic Hammer is back in Tilda's hands.

variants.specifics: Tolmar Cross: Hessel, the stablemaster, lost his Cloak of Warding to crows and imps that overran the stable loft.

offer.speaker: Hessel
offer.text:
Why did you take so long!? We have a terrible problem!

Hideous overgrown crows and flying imps from the Hollow have overrun the stable loft. Two of my stablehands were hurt in defense of the inn's good name!

Please, I beg you! Will you drive off the beasts and fetch back my Cloak of Warding? I'll pay you handsomely.

This key will open the loft door.

I also have a potion that might come in handy.

refusal.speaker: Hessel
refusal.text: No? Well, the cloak is still up there. Come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Hessel
reminder.text: Come back to me once the loft is clear and the cloak is mine again, and you'll be paid well.

completion.speaker: Hessel
completion.text:
You are a true champion! My deepest thanks.

While you were up in the loft, fighting those crows, Orsk came by, looking for you. He's waiting for you at the Warden's Post -- north of here.

Take this gold and potion for your trouble, before you go.

after.speaker: Hessel
after.text: Orsk is no fool. Best do as he says.

journal.text: Kill the crows and imps in Hessel's stable loft. Recover the Cloak of Warding.

journal_done.text: Go to the Warden's Post and speak with Orsk.

variants.specifics: Tosk: Maudie lost her Staff of Rain to Ogre raiders, who took it to their camp in the northwest.

offer.speaker: Maudie
offer.text: Welcome, Wanderer! Thank goodness you are here at last, for the farms are in terrible need of help. The Ogres came through Tosk the other night and carried off my Staff of Rain! Will you go to the Ogre camp in the northwest and bring back the precious staff at once?

refusal.speaker: Maudie
refusal.text: I'm sorry you feel that way. Come back if you change your mind!

reminder.speaker: Maudie
reminder.text: Hurry and fetch my Staff! Please go quickly! For given half a chance, Brakk will smash the Staff for pure sport, indeed!

completion.speaker: Maudie
completion.text:
Wonderful! Many thanks for bringing the Staff home! With it back in my hands, we can finally put an end to Brakk's raids once and for all!

Here, this Red Potion and this Spell Book may come in handy... sooner than you'd think.

after.speaker: Maudie
after.text: Thanks again, Wanderer, for the Staff.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Maudie's Staff of Rain.
